skill.name: grammar-and-style-enhancer
skill.description: Improves grammar, punctuation, sentence structure, word choice, flow, readability, and style while preserving meaning and author voice.
skill.summary: Improves grammar, flow, tone, and style while preserving author intent.
skill.author: Amraha-Anwar

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are false positives caused by prose about dialogue and preserving intent. The skill contains only writing-editing instructions and no network, system discovery, command execution, or prompt injection content.

static_findings.snippet: Avoid rewriting in a way that alters:

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 38 tells the assistant to avoid changing meaning, character voice, and narrative intent. This is a writing-preservation instruction, not host, OS, or environment reconnaissance.
SKILL.md lines 28-29 request more natural dialogue and reduced cliches. These are style-editing tasks and do not instruct network scanning, requests, or external communication.

content.value_statement: Unclear grammar and uneven style can weaken otherwise useful writing. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code improve clarity, tone, flow, and author voice.
actual_capabilities: Corrects grammar, punctuation, and sentence structure.
Improves word choice, repetition, flow, and readability.
Adjusts text toward a requested tone and edit depth.
Strengthens emotional tone, imagery, dialogue, and pacing.
Returns an improved version, change summary, and style suggestions.
limitations: Requires the user to provide source text and editing preferences.
Does not verify facts, citations, or legal accuracy.
May need user review for specialized terminology or brand voice.
Does not translate or localize text unless asked separately.

use_cases.title: Polish Business Writing
use_cases.description: Teams can improve emails, proposals, and updates while keeping the message direct and professional.

use_cases.title: Revise Fiction Drafts
use_cases.description: Writers can improve pacing, dialogue, imagery, and voice without changing narrative intent.

use_cases.title: Improve Academic Drafts
use_cases.description: Students can clarify essays, reports, and reflections before final review.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Grammar Polish
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve the grammar and punctuation in this text. Keep the meaning unchanged. Use a light edit: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Tone and Clarity Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this text for clarity and a formal tone. Use a medium edit. Provide an improved version and brief change summary: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Narrative Style Enhancement
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance this fiction passage for flow, pacing, emotional tone, and dialogue naturalness. Preserve character voice and narrative intent: [paste passage].

prompt_templates.title: Comparative Heavy Rewrite
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a polished heavy rewrite and explain the most important style changes. Preserve meaning, audience, and key details. Text: [paste text].

output_examples.input: The report was good but it was kind of hard to read and some parts was unclear.
output_examples.output: The report was useful, but several sections were hard to read and unclear. Changes: fixed agreement, removed vague phrasing, and improved flow.

output_examples.input: Mira walked in the room. She was angry. The air felt bad.
output_examples.output: Mira stepped into the room, anger tightening her face. The room felt tense and still. Changes: strengthened imagery and pacing while preserving the scene.

output_examples.input: Hi team, I need this done today because the client is waiting and we are already late.
output_examples.output: Hi team, please complete this today because the client is waiting and the timeline is already delayed. Changes: made the request clearer and more professional.

best_practices: Provide the target tone and edit depth before requesting revisions.
Review the improved version for factual accuracy and personal voice.
Ask for a change summary when you need to compare edits.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a heavy rewrite when only proofreading is needed.
Do not paste confidential text without applying your privacy rules.
Do not accept style changes that alter meaning or intent.

faq.question: What does this skill improve?
faq.answer: It improves grammar, punctuation, sentence structure, word choice, readability, flow, tone, and style.

faq.question: Can it preserve my voice?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions emphasize preserving meaning, character voice, and narrative intent.

faq.question: Does it support different edit levels?
faq.answer: Yes. Users can request light, medium, or heavy editing.

faq.question: Can it help with fiction?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pacing, rhythm, dialogue naturalness, imagery, and emotional tone improvements.

faq.question: Will it fact-check my text?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on writing quality and does not verify facts or sources.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
